title: About SK Attestation Services
headline: Independent guidance. Clear responsibility.
description: We help people in Pakistan understand document requests for Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

sections.title: Our role
sections.text: We help clarify requirements, compare document issues and organise the questions to ask official platforms, issuers and recipients. We do not perform official authentication or make verification decisions.

sections.title: How we work
sections.text: Start with a description of your document and intended use. Identify the request and any issue. Agree the exact scope before choosing paid assistance.

sections.title: A clear boundary
sections.text: We do not claim appointed-agent status or government affiliation. Restricted and applicant-only steps stay with the applicant or the officially permitted provider.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: Use the contact page to ask about your situation. Please confirm an appointment before visiting the Rawalpindi office.
